company_name: United Continental Holdings, Inc. (fka Continental Airlines, Inc.)

fuel_consumption.source_quote: Impact of $1 increase in price per barrel of aircraft fuel on annual fuel expense (based on 2016 projected fuel consumption): $94 million (implies ~3,948 million projected gallons for 2016).

instrument_type_details.notes: UAL consolidated at Dec 31, 2015: 17% of 2016 fuel (652 million gallons) hedged. Instruments based on aircraft fuel or crude oil; includes fixed-price swaps, call options, collars, three-ways, four-way collars. Fair value liability $124 million. Collateral deposited $26 million. Hedges expiring through December 2016.
